job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: The document is KCERA’s 2024 actuarial audit services RFP, not the TMRS global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria and weights are for a different issuer and service and do not support the requested facts.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is issued by the Kern County Employees’ Retirement Association (“KCERA”) for the purpose of soliciting proposals from qualified actuarial firms
The weighted factors listed below will be considered by KCERA when evaluating the firms’ submittals.
Firm’s Experience and Capabilities 30% Quality of Assigned Professional Personnel 25% Communication (Written and Verbal) 25% Cost 20%
